column3: Close to the Hebrew.
The Hebrew says “the people” twice; BSB uses “the troops” and then “their number.”
The Hebrew repeats the comparison “like them and like them”; BSB expresses only the hundredfold multiplication.
The Hebrew says “the people, Israel”; BSB uses “the troops of Israel.”
